name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  python:
    name: Python (lint + typecheck + tests)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "agents/uv.lock"

      - name: Install Python 3.14
        run: uv python install 3.14

      - name: Lock Python dependencies
        working-directory: agents
        run: bash lock-versions.sh

      - name: Run CI suite (ruff + mypy + pytest + dataset validation)
        working-directory: agents
        env:
          LLM_API_KEY: ci-mock-key
          AUTOSRE_LLM__API_KEY: ci-mock-key
          AUTOSRE_LLM__BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:1/never-called
          AUTOSRE_POSTGRES__PASSWORD: ci-mock
          AUTOSRE_POSTGRES__HOST: 127.0.0.1
          AUTOSRE_POSTGRES__PORT: "1"
          AUTOSRE_POSTGRES__DB: ci_mock
          AUTOSRE_POSTGRES__USER: ci_mock
          AUTOSRE_OPENOBSERVE__EMAIL: ci@example.invalid
          AUTOSRE_OPENOBSERVE__PASSWORD: ci-mock
          AUTOSRE_OPENOBSERVE__URL: http://127.0.0.1:1
          AUTOSRE_ALERT__WEBHOOK_SECRET: ci-mock
          AUTOSRE_VALKEY__HOST: 127.0.0.1
          AUTOSRE_VALKEY__PORT: "1"
          AUTOSRE_VALKEY__PASSWORD: ci-mock
        run: bash test_e2e.sh --ci

  frontend:
    name: Frontend (typecheck + lint + build)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: agents/ui/package-lock.json

      - name: Lock Node dependencies
        working-directory: agents/ui
        run: bash lock-versions.sh

      - name: Validate (typecheck + lint + build)
        working-directory: agents/ui
        run: bash validate.sh
